title: David - a man after God's heart
introduction: David was Israel's greatest king, a warrior, poet, and prophet. God called him a man after His own heart. His life shows both the heights of faith and the depths of sin—and God's grace to those who turn back. Through David came the promise of the Messiah.

sections.title: The Young Shepherd
sections.description: God looked at the heart and chose the youngest son as king.

sections.title: David and Goliath
sections.description: With faith in God, David defeated the giant whom all Israel feared.

sections.title: David's Sin and Repentance
sections.description: Even God's chosen can fall—but grace is greater for those who repent.

sections.title: David's Songs of Praise
sections.description: David wrote many psalms that express the whole human relationship with God.

sections.title: David's Lineage - The Messiah
sections.description: God promised David that his offspring would sit on the throne forever—fulfilled in Jesus.
